titleEn: Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Education, Youth, and Sport

articles.en: The Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport is hereby established under the Royal Government of Cambodia.

The Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport shall have the competence to lead and administer the education, youth and sport sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
Article 3: The Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport shall be led by a Minister, who may be assisted by Secretaries of State and/or Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
Article 4: The organisational structure and functioning of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport shall be determined by sub-decree.

All provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.
Article 6: This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at Phnom Penh, 24 January 1996; respectfully submitted for the King’s signature: Norodom Sihanouk; First Prime Minister, Second Prime Minister; Norodom Ranariddh, Hun Sen.
